policy.check: before env and secret value reads; trusted execution enterprise

env.values: UTF-8 JSON strings without NUL; empty plain values permitted

secrets.delivery: prefix is projected filename only; inject exact unprefixed destination env name
secrets.values: nonblank UTF-8 without NUL; bytes preserved

marker.name: PHOENIX_AGENT_SECRET_NAMES_JSON
marker.value: sorted JSON array of new secret destination names only; absent without new secrets

behavior.admissionAuthority: Engine validates generic delivery and trusted enterprise only; Agents owns named connection/native runtime capability admission
behavior.collisions: reject new plain/secret overlap and overlap with either existing runtime map, even equal or empty values
behavior.generation: one pinned projected generation per load; fresh snapshot per delivery
behavior.legacy: unrelated existing explicit credentials remain unchanged
behavior.privacy: errors contain safe codes/names only; delivered nonempty secrets participate in runtime scrub and Agents tool-boundary protection; canonical secret-bearing output is refused
behavior.retry: safe cancellation, deadline and positive projected-generation change abort the snapshot for retry; unknown unreadable errors remain terminal
behavior.selectedFiles: delivery-policy.json, env.json, exact prefixed secret names
behavior.supportedTarget: opensandbox/linux/agent runtime wiring implemented; activation requires compatible Agents runtime and separately verified deployment
